full_page.content:
1936, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 87 Cont.
Jan. 28 E'd Klein - 26 - fears loss of eye-piece of steel lodged in same; so far operation unsuccessful.
29 Sylvester Drewck - 24 - Arthritis ... went to a "healer" to supersti- tious practices.
Fred Messier - 42 - Shell-shocked in Grace Hosp'l fire 15 months ago. Now almost OK. Wants prayers of thanksgiving etc .....
+John Steffens - 30 - and Chr. Scie ... wife who survived ... seems very much "materialist".
Page 88
1936, February
Feb. 1 Catherine Swift of Odess, Ont. - 8 - knocked by car- broken leg triple-skull-fracture - unconscious and speechless from Nov. 11 to Nov. 27. Enrolled by phone at time when Drs. had no hope. Now walking on crutches .... as soon as parents had promissed more fre- quent communion Child began at once to improve.
2 Catherine Rocheleau - 16 - failed in school (St. Martin's) and left home - now gone the 4th day. No trace of her so far. Parents and friends anxious ... Enrolled To-day 50c
Henry Glasier - 27 - has wife and one little baby - wife has gone insane. He has never made his confession. Wife a presbiterian - now in Receiving Hospital. He enrolles her To-night & promises to take instruction at once.
Herman Berger - 64 - stroke - one side entirely helpless ..... Mrs. Mary Seria - 34 - mentally unballanced now seven months. .
Vincent & Fern Soules - quite young couple - recently mar. - have one little baby but worried about triffles and are not happy.
3rd. Evelyn Schrank - 9 - nerveous - her father sick with kidney trouble & Blood. 10th-Child & Father reported "wonderfully improved.
Elaine McCrudy - 8 - infantile paralysis 4 month now. In san. near Mt. Clemens.
